name: TC-935: the Deactivate dialog offers pay-or-return per device (return by default) and confirming closes the restaurant out
description: HQ → Restaurants → row menu → Deactivate loads GET /api/admin/close-out/restaurants/:id/devices and lists each RestauNax device under 'RestauNax equipment' with 'Owner returns it' (selected) and 'Owner keeps it at list price ($…)'. With no live subscription there is no timing choice: Deactivate closes out now — PUT /api/admin/restaurants/:id/status carries the RETURN choice and the devices endpoint then reports closedOutAt.
